about: c12/c13 inserts (user on c11: 「還不夠，繼續加」, then reuse existing material for free). Each insert cuts away from a c11 shot and back without moving any c11 cut: the c11 shot keeps its own clock underneath (main.js pickShot), so it resumes where it would have been. A 'take' insert plays a window of an earlier generated take at normal speed (seq.py writes seq/<id>, source SHA-256 checked); a 'still' insert is an approved plate moved by the code camera. Camera [centre x, centre y, zoom] in source px, 'from' -> 'to'. start: 'at_word' [line, word] two frames early like build.py's vocal cuts, or 'at_beat' (index into beats.json). end: the same, or 'cut' (the insert runs into that c11 cut, or c13: into the next insert). Rule (user on the takes): no visible singing mouth, no frown; only hands/profile/eyes/hair/wide/environment moments. 'pips' are picture-in-picture insets (480x270 frames under comp/pip/<id>, drawn on the feed layer by main.js). c13: 'mark': true means the take carries no burned-in platform label (the N takes), so the comp draws the AI mark even at 1.0; 'at_beat' may be a half index (the eighth between two beats). c12's edit: inserts-c12.json. c15: the story takes ST1-ST4, ST6 (user 「只用合格的片段」: only each take's usable span) cut in like the other take inserts; 'start' may also be 'cut' (the insert starts on that c11 cut, e.g. ST1 on S2's cut). The comp no longer draws any AI mark (user: the visible 「AI生成」 removed); 'mark' is kept for the record only. c14's edit: inserts-c14.json.
